defect: design intent asks for finger scallops; they are missing
summary: Dimensions, fit, clearance and printability all pass, but the design_intent 'reinforced loop with finger scallops' is not delivered: the loop is a plain racetrack with the same 4 mm wall as the ring — no scallops on the finger-facing edge and no local thickening.

discrepancies.where: TOP view / detail — loop inner and outer edges
discrepancies.expected: Finger scallops (two concave depressions on the finger-contact edge of the loop) so two adult fingers seat comfortably under load, per design_intent.
discrepancies.observed: Loop is a plain oval/racetrack; inner edge is a smooth constant-radius curve with no scalloping.
discrepancies.suggestion: Add two shallow concave scallops (~R12–15, ~2–3 mm deep) on the outer top edge of the loop (or on the inner long edges) spaced ~18–20 mm apart so each finger has a seat. Keep the remaining wall ≥ 2.5 mm.

discrepancies.where: SECTION A-A / TOP detail — loop wall thickness
discrepancies.expected: A 'reinforced' loop, i.e. a loop section visibly stouter than the ring wall or with a local rib, to carry the 1.5 kg × 2 finger load with margin.
discrepancies.observed: Loop wall is ~4.0 mm, identical to the ring wall and the bridge wall — no reinforcement is visible.
discrepancies.suggestion: Thicken the loop rim to ~5–6 mm (in-plane), or increase the loop's Z-height locally (e.g. an 8–10 mm tall boss around the loop) so the finger-bearing member is stiffer and more comfortable than a thin flat strap.
